name: 🥦 Beef & Broccoli Wok Night
tagline: Better than takeout: tender flank steak and broccoli in a glossy ginger-garlic sauce.

items.name: Soy sauce (low sodium if we have it)

steps.text: Rice on first (it's done when dinner is).
Slice the steak very thin against the grain (15 minutes in the freezer makes it easy). Toss with 1 Tbsp soy and 1 Tbsp cornstarch.
Sauce: whisk the rest of the soy, the brown sugar, sesame oil, 1 Tbsp cornstarch and the water.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a wok or big skillet over high. Add the broccoli and 3 Tbsp water; cover and steam-fry 3 minutes. Tip out.
Add 2 Tbsp oil. Sear the beef in two batches, 1–2 minutes each, without crowding.
Lower the heat, add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the sauce. It thickens in a minute.
Toss the beef and broccoli back in to coat. Serve over rice.

kid_jobs.job: Rinse the rice and start it with a grown-up
Peel the ginger with a spoon

chef_tip: Sear the beef in two batches in a really hot pan. Crowd it and it steams gray; give it room and you get those browned, takeout-style edges.
make_ahead: Slice and marinate the beef and mix the sauce up to a day ahead.
leftovers: Reheat in a skillet with a splash of water; great over rice in a thermos.
swaps: Frozen stir-fry vegetables (i243) with the broccoli
heads_up: Rice first; steak into the freezer 15 min for easy slicing.
